0022600116.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (2-0, 1st in the Northwest) host the LA Clippers (1-1, 3rd in the Pacific) in the Thunder's third game of the season, and Oklahoma City has won both of its games so far, including its only home game. The Thunder will be without Nikola Topic (back, surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles, surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee, surgery), while the Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee, inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), Max Strus (foot, plantar fasciitis), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery). The Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 128-110 win in Los Angeles on April 8, 2026, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27.
